z1_benbow_ask_g3.speaker: benbow
z1_benbow_ask_g3.text: Look at the map! Where does the golden path go first?

z1_benbow_ask_g4.speaker: benbow
z1_benbow_ask_g4.text: Read the bottle message carefully! Which way should we travel to reach the jungle camp?

z1_benbow_hi_g3.speaker: benbow
z1_benbow_hi_g3.text: Welcome to Treasure Island, explorer! Find the glass bottle by the shallow water and bring me the secret map!

z1_benbow_win.speaker: benbow
z1_benbow_win.text: Brilliant work! Take this golden compass! The jungle gate is open now!

z1_benbow_hi_g4.speaker: benbow
z1_benbow_hi_g4.text: Ahoy, brave explorer! Someone left a glass bottle near the shallow bay. Pick it up and read the first clue!

z1_parrot_tip.speaker: parrot
z1_parrot_tip.text: Squawk! Follow me! You can splash in the shallow water or rest on the hammock!

z2_cook_planks_g3.speaker: cook
z2_cook_planks_g3.text: Awesome! Now carry the three past-tense planks to fix the bridge: walked, jumped, sailed!

z2_cook_hi_g3.speaker: cook
z2_cook_hi_g3.text: Hello, friend! My wooden bridge broke yesterday! First, tap the three giant shells in my song order: blue, pink, yellow!

z2_cook_hi_g4.speaker: cook
z2_cook_hi_g4.text: Welcome to my jungle kitchen! A storm broke our creek bridge! First, listen and tap the giant musical shells: blue, pink, green, yellow!

z2_cook_planks_g4.speaker: cook
z2_cook_planks_g4.text: Fantastic! Now carry the three adventure planks to repair the bridge: explored, climbed, discovered!

z2_cook_win.speaker: cook
z2_cook_win.text: Hooray! You fixed the wooden bridge! Cross the creek to the boat lagoon!

z2_parrot_shells.speaker: parrot
z2_parrot_shells.text: Listen closely! Tap the glowing giant shells in the right order!

z3_capt_hi_g3.speaker: captain
z3_capt_hi_g3.text: Ahoy, matey! Hop into the wooden rowing boat on the dock! Row across the deep bay to the old shipwreck!

z3_capt_hi_g4.speaker: captain
z3_capt_hi_g4.text: Ahoy, sailor! The deep sea is too deep for walking, so board the rowing boat and row east to Shipwreck Island!

z3_capt_win.speaker: captain
z3_capt_win.text: Shiver me timbers! You found the spyglass and the lantern! The rope bridge to the lookout tower is open!

z3_parrot_wreck.speaker: parrot
z3_parrot_wreck.text: Look! Inside the shipwreck! Grab the brass spyglass and the glowing cave lantern!

z4_parrot_spy_g3.speaker: parrot
z4_parrot_spy_g3.text: Use your spyglass! Spot the waterfall cave in the north and the two palm trees in the west!

z4_parrot_spy_g4.speaker: parrot
z4_parrot_spy_g4.text: Look through your spyglass! Find the hidden cave behind the waterfall, then spot Treasure Cove in the sunset!

z4_flint_hi_g4.speaker: flint
z4_flint_hi_g4.text: Halt, explorer! Cross the swaying rope bridge, climb the lookout tower, and scan the island with your spyglass!

z4_flint_hi_g3.speaker: flint
z4_flint_hi_g3.text: Squawk! I am Flint! Jump across the swaying rope bridge and climb the tall lookout tower!

z5_capt_clue_g3.speaker: captain
z5_capt_clue_g3.text: Read the final clue! Dig with your shovel between the two tall palm trees near the big grey rock!

z5_capt_clue_g4.speaker: captain
z5_capt_clue_g4.text: Here is Billy's last riddle! Use your shovel to dig between the twin palm trees beside the giant boulder!

z5_finale_win.speaker: captain
z5_finale_win.text: You found the legendary Treasure of Adventure Island! Gold coins and your Passport Stamp are yours!

z5_parrot_wrong.speaker: parrot
z5_parrot_wrong.text: Oops, only crabs and seashells here! Listen to the clue again: between the two palm trees near the big rock!

z4_flint_cave_g3.speaker: flint
z4_flint_cave_g3.text: Hold your lantern inside the dark waterfall cave! Light the three torches: sun, moon, star!

z4_flint_cave_g4.speaker: flint
z4_flint_cave_g4.text: Your lantern lights the dark cave! Touch the three ancient crystals in order: courage, wisdom, treasure!

z4_flint_win.speaker: flint
z4_flint_win.text: Incredible! Take this golden shovel! Sunset Cove is open for the final treasure!
